name: Rizuhble's Target Practice Mirage
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, for your first counter or when slots fill.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for your first counter or when slots fill.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-11,200 (levels 1-18). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Djinn's Mark T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Improved Spirit, vitality 4.8k at Dispel Magic. Ultimate (Traveler) is available from Improved Spirit.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 3.5 to Djinn's Mark's proc damage base (0.35x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Djinn's Mark: takes 18% off its 2.8s base cooldown.
items.legacy_note: On Djinn's Mark. Marks stack faster.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Improved Spirit completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Toxic Bullets, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Healbane
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Dispel Magic, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus. Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 11,200-28,800 (levels 18-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Fire Scarabs T3, Dust Devil T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Dust Devil, damage) grows from 150 to 228. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Toxic Bullets.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k weapon tier, which Extended Magazine completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Extended Magazine completes 6.4k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 54 to 74% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Bounced bullets put marks on two more of them.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 9,600 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 201s; 20% off is 40.2s per full rotation.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 28,800-51,200 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Traveler T3.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 27 to Dust Devil's damage (0.90x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Headhunter
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 15,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Titanic Magazine.
sections.desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Titanic Magazine.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is out-shooting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hitting you.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Dust Devil (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences keep stopping your combo.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming, like Bebop's hook or Apollo's ult.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: On Djinn's Mark. Sell Toxic Bullets for this.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Replaces Dispel Magic: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
